title: Network Device SSH Version 2
description: DISA STIG: The network device must use SSH Version 2 for all remote management sessions. SSH v1 is vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks.

title: Telnet Prohibited
description: DISA STIG: The network device must not use Telnet for remote management. Telnet sends all data in cleartext.
remediation: Disable telnet: transport input ssh (all VTY lines)

title: AAA Required
description: DISA STIG: The network device must use AAA authentication for all management access. Local-only auth is not sufficient for classified environments.
remediation: Configure: aaa new-model / aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local

title: TACACS+ or RADIUS for AAA
description: DISA STIG: Authentication must be performed using a centralized AAA server (TACACS+ or RADIUS), not only local accounts.
remediation: Configure: aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local

title: Enable Secret Required
description: DISA STIG: The network device must use an enable secret (type 5 or higher) for privileged EXEC mode.

title: SNMPv3 Required
description: DISA STIG: The network device must use SNMPv3 with authentication and privacy. SNMPv1 and v2c are prohibited.
remediation: Configure: snmp-server group <name> v3 priv / snmp-server user <name> <group> v3 auth sha <auth_pw> priv aes 128 <priv_pw>

title: No Default SNMP Community Strings
description: DISA STIG: The network device must not use 'public' or 'private' SNMP community strings.
remediation: Remove default SNMP communities: no snmp-server community public / no snmp-server community private

title: NTP Configured with Authentication
description: DISA STIG: The network device must synchronize its clock using authenticated NTP servers.
remediation: Configure: ntp authenticate / ntp authentication-key 1 md5 <key> / ntp trusted-key 1 / ntp server <ip> key 1

title: Password Encryption Enabled
description: DISA STIG: The network device must encrypt all passwords using strong algorithms.

title: HTTP Server Disabled
description: DISA STIG: The HTTP server on the device must be disabled. Only HTTPS or console/SSH management is authorized.

title: MOTD Banner Required
description: DISA STIG: The network device must display a DoD-approved banner before granting access.
remediation: Configure banner motd with DoD warning text

title: Remote Syslog Configured
description: DISA STIG: The network device must send log data to a centralized log server for monitoring.
remediation: Configure: logging host <SYSLOG_IP> transport udp port 514

title: VTY Exec Timeout ≤ 10 minutes
description: DISA STIG: The network device must terminate management sessions after 10 minutes of inactivity.

title: VTY ACL Applied
description: DISA STIG: An ACL must restrict which management hosts can access VTY lines.
remediation: Configure: ip access-list standard MGMT-ACL / permit <mgmt_subnet> / line vty 0 15 / access-class MGMT-ACL in
